# EU AI Act — compliance snapshot

The **EU AI Act** is the first comprehensive AI regulation in the EU, with obligations phased from 2025 through 2027.[^1]

## High-risk systems

Providers of high-risk AI systems must complete conformity assessment and maintain technical documentation before placing systems on the market.[^2]

## General-purpose AI

Models classified as having systemic risk face extra evaluation and transparency requirements.[^3]
